statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of transient loss of consciousness and brief neurological deficits suggestive of a transient cerebral ischemic attack, raising concern for a cardiogenic etiology.
Mobile cardiac telemetry, CPT 93229, was ordered to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias that may be contributing to the syncopal events and potential cerebral hypoperfusion.
The claim was denied under CO-197.
